data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 旧书馆的稿纸晨光·「灵感这种东西，是偷懒者的借口」
data.description: 【学校旧书馆·清晨】晨光从高窗落下，诗羽坐在旧书架间的长桌前，稿纸铺满桌面。她咬着钢笔尾端思考的样子罕见地认真，白衬衫的袖口挽到手肘——「嗯？被看到了呢……灵感这种东西是偷懒者的借口。写作，靠的是纪律。……不过，你坐过来的话，效率确实会变高就是了。」
data.action: 咬笔杆思考写稿，挽袖白衬衫，红瞳认真
data.lighting: 高窗落下的丁达尔晨光
data.camera: medium shot, manuscript writing, dust motes, focused mood
data.promptProse: Seated at the library table, Utaha rests the pen end against her lips over the manuscript. A morning beam from the high window crosses the scattered pages and her writing hand, revealing dust in the air.
data.animaCaption: The pen end rests against her lips above the manuscript beneath the high window.
